alternatives.option: reading the version from package.json or a lockfile

context: Released twining-mcp 2.6.0, migrated the benchmark harness to v2, and fixed its version-control and scorer-recognition defects (steps 1-3)
rationale: the pre/post comparison requires two arms of the same run to launch different server versions, which only a per-run override supports; a default pin keeps ordinary runs reproducible
summary: Chose to make TWINING_MCP_SPEC an env-overridable pin with an explicit default rather than reading the version from package.json or a lockfile
